name: OpenVibe.Chat

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (Chat's database and the Live sync are what /ready checks)

drains: server_restart notice broadcast to every chat socket
Live sync, outbox relay, Live mirror, Events consumer and subscriptions stopped
chat and call WebSocket servers closed
HTTP server closed, then the database
shutdown.note: at most 3 s of mirror flush, then a forced exit 5 s later

resumes.what: a first sync with Live (waited on for at most 15 s) runs before the socket listens
clients reconnect after the restart notice; the audio queue finishes rows that were playing and plays the rest once a room has listeners again; call rooms left open are closed with reason restart
unsent events in the outbox and changes queued in live_mirror_outbox (the read mirror Live keeps for a rollback) are sent again

OpenVibe.Events redelivers the events of Chat's subscriptions (network.block.changed, network.user.token_valid_after, live.release.deployed, …) that were pending during the stop (at least once, deduped by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

claims.what: a Live release's deploy card (deploy_releases, keyed by the head commit)
claims.holder: the first path that stores it: the Live bridge or the live.release.deployed event
claims.expires: never (the row stays); a live.release.deployed older than 6 hours announces nothing
claims.fencing: the claim and the card are written in one transaction, so the second path folds into the existing card instead of posting another

notes: Wave 6: Live's chat (WebSocket, DMs, history, TTS, sounds, moderation) behind a service boundary on 127.0.0.1:4400, serving Live's chat paths since 2026-09-23. Since 2026-09-24 also its own site, openvibe.chat (global chat, messages, settings, sign-in with the Network), which works while Live is down.

exposure.note: openvibe.chat since 2026-09-24 (global chat, messages, settings); also serves Live's chat paths

site.name: Chat
site.what: Global chat, rooms, stream chat and direct messages under one account, with or without JavaScript.
